name: Virginia
summary: The state seal on blue: Virtus, the Roman goddess of virtue, dressed as an Amazon, standing over a defeated tyrant with a fallen crown, with the motto 'Sic Semper Tyrannis' (Thus always to tyrants).
origin: The seal was designed in 1776 by George Mason and others. The flag with the seal was adopted on 30 April 1861, when Virginia seceded; a white fringe was added in 1950.

symbols.name: Virtus
symbols.description: A woman holding a spear and a sheathed sword, her foot on a defeated man.
symbols.meaning: Virtue and the victory of the Revolution over tyranny.

symbols.name: Defeated tyrant
symbols.description: A man lying with a fallen crown, a whip and a broken chain.

facts: It is the only US state flag depicting nudity: Virtus has one breast exposed, as in classical depictions of Amazons.
The motto 'Sic Semper Tyrannis' was shouted by John Wilkes Booth after shooting Lincoln.
Virginia is one of four US Commonwealths.
clues: A woman with a spear standing over a fallen tyrant, on blue.
Its motto means 'Thus always to tyrants'.
